def isArmstrong (n : Nat) (h_precond : isArmstrong_precond (n)) : Bool :=
  if n = 0 then true
  else
    let d := countDigits n
    let sum := List.foldl (fun acc d => acc + d ^ d) 0 (List.map (fun c => c.toNat - '0'.toNat) (toString n).toList)
    sum = n
